title: Stage gates
intro: The product gates G1 to G6 of this transformation: readiness of every required output, submission and the approver's decision.
businessApprovalBody: A stage gate is a business approval decided by the configured approver, a person. This software checks readiness and records the decision; it never approves anything itself.

approverBasis.configured_role: Decided as a holder of the configured approver role
approverBasis.default_role: Decided as a holder of the default approver role

readinessIntro: Evaluated now from the recorded data. Unverified evidence never completes an output that needs verified evidence.
unverifiedNote: Unverified: does not count until a reviewer verifies it.
notEnabledBody: Submission of this gate becomes available in a later release.
anyRoleHolder: Any holder of this role on the transformation
reloaded: The gate was reloaded with the current data.

missingItems.g1__baseline__measurable_missing: No baseline has a value, a source and a baseline date.
missingItems.g1__baseline__verified_evidence_missing: A measurable baseline needs verified evidence (a filename or an inaccessible link does not count).
missingItems.g1__case_for_change__missing: The charter does not state the case for change.
missingItems.g1__diagnostic__confidence_missing: T01 row without a confidence rating
missingItems.g1__diagnostic__current_state_missing: T01 row without a current state
missingItems.g1__diagnostic__dimensions_missing: Not every T01 dimension row exists.
missingItems.g1__diagnostic__root_cause_missing: T01 row without a root cause
missingItems.g1__diagnostic__verified_evidence_missin: T01 row needs a linked baseline or verified evidence (a filename or an inaccessible link does not count)
missingItems.g1__root_causes__confirmed_finding_missi: No confirmed finding is classified as a root cause.
missingItems.g1__root_causes__t01_root_cause_missing: Every T01 row must state a root cause.
missingItems.g1__value_pools__materiality_not_assesse: A value pool's materiality is not assessed.
missingItems.g1__value_pools__quantification_missing: A value pool is neither quantified nor marked unquantified.
missingItems.g2__kpi_definitions__no_t02: The Outcome & KPI Tree (T02) has no row.
missingItems.g2__kpi_definitions__not_active: A KPI used in T02 is not active.
missingItems.g2__north_star__missing: No current North Star is set.
missingItems.g2__outcome_tree__good_outcome_test_not_: Outcome does not pass the good outcome test
missingItems.g2__outcome_tree__outcome_without_t02: Top outcome without a T02 row
missingItems.g2__target_trajectory__no_t02: The Outcome & KPI Tree (T02) has no row.
missingItems.g2__target_trajectory__target_date_missi: T02 row without a target date
missingItems.g2__target_trajectory__target_missing: T02 row without a target value
missingItems.g3__capability_gaps__none: No capability with a current and target level is recorded.
missingItems.g3__design_decisions__owner_missing: Open design decision without an owner
missingItems.g3__future_journeys__none: No future-state journey or process is recorded.
missingItems.g3__gap_matrix__none: The TOM Gap Matrix (T03) has no row.
missingItems.g3__tom__box_not_ready: Canvas box not ready (target design and owner)
missingItems.g3__tom__boxes_missing: Not every TOM canvas box exists.
missingItems.gate__criterion_not_evaluable: This required output cannot be evaluated in this release.
missingItems.gate__criterion_incomplete: A mandatory required output is incomplete.

submit.title: Submit {{code}} for decision
submit.description: This freezes a snapshot of the required outputs and their evidence and sends it to the approver. A pending earlier submission is superseded.
submit.incompleteWarning: Only {{complete}} of {{total}} mandatory outputs are complete. The submission will be refused until they all are.
submit.blocked: Submission opens when every mandatory output is complete ({{complete}} of {{total}} now).

decision.title: Decision on {{code}}, submission #{{n}}
decision.description: Your business decision as the configured approver. The rationale is mandatory and is recorded with your name, the submission number and the time.

configure.title: Approver of {{code}}
configure.description: Choose the approver role and, optionally, a named person holding it. Not possible while a submission is pending.
configure.userHint: Optional. Without a name, any holder of the role on this transformation can decide.

history.title: Submission history
history.intro: Every submission keeps its frozen snapshot and, once decided, the decision with its rationale.
history.noDecision: No decision recorded for this submission.

agreements.intro: Playbook Gate 1 rule (B0032): do not proceed with a list of projects; proceed only when the leadership team agrees on the problem, the baseline and the material value pools. Confirm each agreement; your confirmations are recorded with your decision.

item.problem: The leadership team agrees on the problem
item.baseline: The leadership team agrees on the baseline
item.materialValuePools: The leadership team agrees on the material value pools

agreements.blocked: Tick all three confirmations to approve G1.

missing.problem: Not confirmed: agreement on the problem
missing.baseline: Not confirmed: agreement on the baseline
missing.materialValuePools: Not confirmed: agreement on the material value pools

problem.required: G1 approval requires leadership agreement on the problem, the baseline and the material value pools (B0032). Nothing was recorded.
problem.notApplicable: Leadership agreement confirmations apply only to approving G1. Nothing was recorded.
